changes.alertsSubTabs: The Email Alerts section is now split into three tabs — Settings (enable/threshold), Template (email subject and body), and Server settings (SMTP/Graph) — instead of everything on one page
changes.offlineAlertSubjectEditor: The offline-alert message editor (Settings > Alerts) now also lets you customize the email's subject/title — separately for the single-device and multiple-device cases — in addition to the existing body editor
changes.settingsGroupedNav: Reorganized the Settings menu — the various sections are now grouped into tabs (General, Security & Network, Content & Branding, Users & Access) with internal sub-navigation, substantially cutting down the number of options in the sidebar
changes.deviceIpUpdateNameFallback: Fixed a MAC-less device's IP not auto-updating in the FM when it changes address — it always created a new row instead of updating the existing one. It now uses the device's name as a fallback signal, only when it unambiguously identifies a single existing device
changes.offlineAlertIntroEditor: Added a text editor (Settings > Alerts) to customize the offline-device alert email's intro message, replacing the default wording — supports {count} as a placeholder for the number of offline devices
changes.offlineAlertDeviceNameSubject: The offline-device alert email now includes the device's name in the subject when only one is offline, so it can be identified without opening the email — with multiple devices, the subject stays generic since they're still grouped into a single email
changes.deviceUrlManualEdit: Added a Device URL / IP field to the Location tab of a player's settings — lets an admin manually correct a device's address (e.g. after it changed IP and hasn't phoned home yet, or while it's offline), without needing the device to be reachable
changes.repoRenameGhcrFix: Fixed the FM getting stuck reporting no available update — the GitHub repository was renamed, and the CI build was silently publishing new images under the new name while this app was still pulling the old one
changes.playerUpdateCheckFix: Fixed a player's own "Update available" check never firing — the device's version string format had changed and the check silently failed to parse it, so the Update button never appeared even when a newer build existed. The button now also shows which version is available.
changes.playerUpdateCheckGhcrOrderingFix: Fixed the player Update button sometimes reappearing right after a successful update — "latest available version" was being guessed from the registry's tag list order, which isn't chronological, so it could point at an old build and make an already up-to-date device look outdated. It's now resolved from the actual published "latest" image instead of guessed from list position.
changes.migrateImageSudoFix: Fixed migrating/rebuilding a device sometimes failing with "permission denied" connecting to Docker — device management commands now run with sudo instead of assuming the SSH user is already in the device's docker group
changes.provisionMissingProjectDirFix: Fixed provisioning a new device failing at the "Upload Configuration" step with a "No such file or directory" error — the docker-compose.yml destination folder is now created before writing to it
changes.provisionTimezoneScopingFix: Fixed provisioning sometimes crashing with a Python scoping error while registering the new device — a redundant conditional import was shadowing a date/time helper used elsewhere in the same step
changes.provisionWaitReadyTimeoutFix: Fixed provisioning sometimes timing out at "Waiting for player API" even though the device came up fine shortly after — a fresh device's first boot (running its database setup) can take a bit longer than the previous budget allowed
changes.provisionHostAgentFix: Fixed the device's own splash screen getting stuck on "Detecting network…" forever after provisioning — a background helper process needed to report the device's IP address was missing from newly provisioned devices
changes.sidebarNavPersonalPreference: Left sidebar navigation is now a personal preference every user picks for themselves (Settings > General), instead of a single admin-controlled toggle that forced the same layout on everyone
changes.footerMessagesFeature: New: Footer Messages — create scrolling ticker messages and choose which devices show them at the bottom of the screen, with an animated bar on the device side. Initial version; more polish (icon image, per-message scheduling) is coming
changes.phoneHomeInfoGuardFix: Fixed a device's IP/status sometimes never updating again after its first heartbeat — a fresh install's phone-home script was missing a safeguard (already present in the manual reinstall script) against an edge case that made every subsequent heartbeat fail silently
changes.playlistOrderFix: Fixed playlist content playing back in the wrong order on the device — the intended order is now sent explicitly instead of relying on creation order
changes.migrateImageTimeoutFix: Fixed migrating/rebuilding a device sometimes reporting a timeout even though it was still working — the underlying request now has enough time to wait through a device reboot
changes.playlistRemoveFromDevices: Unchecking a device/group/location in a playlist's "Apply to" now also removes its content from there, instead of only stopping future redeploys
changes.screenshotCanvasFix: Fixed a landscape device's screenshot being cropped top and bottom by an overly wide canvas
changes.editorSimplificadoRole: The playlist-target restriction is now a dedicated role — Simplified Editor (Settings > Users) — instead of an admin toggle affecting every editor
changes.playerDetailBackButtonLayout: Fixed the back button on a device's details page dropping to its own line — it now sits on the same line as the name, status and location
changes.navbarLogoSpacingTighter: Reduced the gap between the MupiTech logo and the navbar divider
changes.playlistTargetRestriction: Admins can now restrict editors from changing which devices a playlist targets (Settings > Editor Permissions) — editors keep full control over its content and deploying it
changes.playlistScheduleAdHocTargets: A playlist schedule can now target different devices/groups/locations than the playlist's own configuration, instead of always reusing it
changes.sessionExpiryRedirectFix: Fixed an expired session sometimes not redirecting back to the login screen — a backend authentication ordering issue meant "not logged in" and "logged in but not allowed" looked identical to the app
changes.sidebarCollapsedWidthFix: Collapsing the sidebar now actually widens the content area to use the freed-up space, instead of leaving it empty
changes.cecStatusFalsePositive: Fixed CEC status wrongly showing as available (with the power buttons enabled but not working) on a plain monitor without CEC support — a real "no CEC display" answer from the device wasn't being recognized as such
changes.navbarPartnerLogoPolish: The partner logo in the navbar is now evenly spaced around the divider and clickable, same as the MupiTech logo
changes.editorButtonsRespectCapabilities: Device-management buttons (delete, reboot, edit, SSH terminal, branding/image settings tabs) are now hidden for editors who don't have the matching capability, instead of showing and then failing
changes.fleetOverviewMoveMode: The move-device/move-group arrows on Fleet Overview are now hidden by default — turn on "Move devices/groups" in the page header to show them
changes.fleetOverviewChipContrast: Fixed device chips on Fleet Overview being nearly invisible (white on white) in light mode
changes.fleetOverviewButtonConsistency: Made the "Add group" and "Add location" buttons on Fleet Overview look the same
changes.playerDetailInlineBadges: The online/offline badge and location chip on a device's details page now sit inline with its name instead of on separate lines
changes.contentRootVisibility: Content that isn't in any folder is now hidden from editors by default — enable "Show unorganized content to editors" in Settings > Content Folders to restore it
changes.scopedFoldersPanel: A location or group's detail view now shows its content folders, with a quick way to create a new one scoped to it
changes.editorGranularPermissions: Admins can now grant editors specific device-management abilities (power control, branding, image management, SSH credentials, etc.) individually, in Settings > Editor Permissions — editors still default to content-only
changes.editorForcedToLoginFix: Fixed non-admin users getting kicked back to the login screen when opening a device's details — a permission-denied response on one internal request was being wrongly treated as a session timeout
changes.playerDetailStatusChipAlignFix: Fixed the location chip on a device's details page not lining up with the online/offline status badge
changes.locationWithoutGroupFix: Fixed a device assigned to a location without a group not actually showing up under that location in Fleet Overview and the Locations page
changes.editorContentOnly: Editors can now only manage content on devices (assign/update/remove assets, clone content between devices) — adding/editing/removing a device, its credentials, OS image, power, or branding now requires an admin
changes.emailLogoOutlookFix: Fixed the MupiTech logo not showing at all in emails opened in classic Outlook (it now travels as a real inline attachment instead of a data: URI, which classic Outlook doesn't render)
changes.folderCountFix: Fixed a folder's content count including files sitting in the recycle bin — it now matches what's actually visible, and updates correctly on delete
changes.brandedLogoBadgeFix: Fixed the small MupiTech credit badge never showing in the corner of a branded device's boot/splash screen
changes.emailViaGraph: Email sending (offline alerts, email 2FA codes, password resets) can now go through Microsoft Graph as an alternative to SMTP — Settings > Alerts
changes.navbarLogoSpacing: Tightened the gap between the MupiTech logo and the partner-logo divider in the top bar
changes.brandingLibraryUrlFix: Fixed uploading to the shared logo/standby image library failing with a "POST not allowed" error
changes.sidebarNavbarShorter: The top bar is now shorter when the sidebar layout is on, since navigation already lives in the sidebar
changes.bootSplashProvision: Fresh Pi installs via the Fleet Manager now install the animated MupiTech boot splash too (previously only baked into a from-scratch image build) — visible from the device's next reboot
changes.standbyPushFix: Fixed the custom standby image/video not taking effect on the device after being pushed from Settings
changes.navbarSidebarFix: Fixed the top-bar logo floating mid-screen instead of sitting flush left when the sidebar layout is on
changes.migratePi4Pi5: Migrate/rebuild to the MupiTech image is now available for Raspberry Pi 4/5 devices too (was x86-only) — open for real-hardware testing
changes.weatherWidget: New first-party "Weather" app (Add content > Apps > MupiTech) — a fully translated, animated weather widget, no external service required
changes.locationSearchField: Apps with a location setting now offer a type-to-search address field alongside the manual latitude/longitude inputs
changes.appsCatalog: New "Apps" tab when adding content — browse the same public signage-app catalog the device itself offers, configure it, and add it straight to your library
changes.sidebarButtonFix: Fixed the sidebar's collapse button being clipped off at the edge
changes.contentLibraryScoping: Content library: folders can now have subfolders, be scoped to a location/group, or marked common (Settings > Content Library) — an editor with restricted access only sees folders/files relevant to their own area, plus common ones
changes.sidebarPolish: Sidebar layout: the Fleet section is now a collapsible accordion, the whole-sidebar collapse button moved to an always-visible spot on the edge, and both now animate smoothly
changes.fmManagedBadge: A device paired with a Fleet Manager now shows a "Managed by Fleet Manager" badge on its own local dashboard after login
changes.duoIpFix: Fixed Duo push notifications not reporting the real request IP (showed as 0.0.0.0 in Duo's own admin console)
changes.sidebarNavLayout: New experimental layout (Settings > General, superadmin-only): a collapsible left sidebar instead of the top navbar's menu — opt-in and reversible, doesn't remove the current layout
changes.devicePairingFeature: New: device pairing — a fresh device with no prior credentials can now request to join your fleet (Players > Devices awaiting approval), instead of needing SSH access or the device's IP known up front
changes.accountTabsRedesign: "My Profile" and Settings > MFA Providers now use side/tab navigation instead of stacking everything on one page
changes.mfaMethodTiles: Alternate MFA methods on the login screen are now icon tiles (hover for the name) instead of a stacked list of text links
changes.darkModeOutlineButtonFix: Fixed low-contrast outline buttons in dark mode (e.g. the device Access tab's "Reveal credentials"/"Restore" buttons) that were nearly unreadable against the dark background
changes.emailOtpMfaFeature: New MFA method: email code — enable it in Settings > Security to get a 6-digit code emailed to your account address at login, no authenticator app required
changes.passwordResetFeature: New: password recovery — the "Forgot your password?" link on the login page emails a secure, single-use link (valid for a few hours) to set a new password
changes.mfaCodeBoxesAndAnimations: Device MFA login now shows 6 separate code boxes (matching the Fleet Manager) instead of a single field, with fade in/out animations; also added subtle animations when switching methods or completing verification, on both the Fleet Manager and the device
changes.rateLimitGroupFix: Fixed a bug where two different endpoints sharing the same rate limit could accidentally share the same counter, causing incorrect, premature blocks (403) instead of the expected rate limit (429)
changes.setupWizardFeature: New: first-run setup wizard — on a fresh install (no superadmin yet), the app walks through creating the first admin account and, optionally, a partner logo, instead of requiring a manual 'manage.py createsuperuser'
changes.deviceLoginMfaFeature: Logging into a device directly with an MFA-enrolled account now works — it used to always be blocked, telling you to use the Fleet Manager's own SSO instead
changes.mobileNavbarFixes: Fixed 4 mobile menu issues: the menu toggle button being pushed off-screen on standard iPhones, the language/user buttons having no styling at all, the menu not closing after picking an option, and the active Settings tab resetting on page refresh
changes.fleetManagerRebrand: Replaced "Fleet Manager" (the pre-rebrand name) with "Gestor de Mupis Digitais" across all currently-visible text — emails, settings hints, confirmations, and more
changes.brandedAlertEmails: Alert emails (the SMTP test and the real offline-device alert) now use a branded HTML template with the MupiTech logo (or a partner logo, if configured) and Portuguese text, instead of plain English text
changes.dualMfaLogin: New: dual MFA — require two MFA challenges from different providers to log in, either by role (Settings > MFA Providers) or self-service opt-in (Settings > Security)
changes.lastSuperadminGuard: The last superadmin can no longer be demoted (by themselves or anyone else), preventing a Fleet Manager with nobody left holding full access
changes.offlineAlertPreview: New button under Settings > Alerts to preview the real offline-device alert template, not just generic test text
changes.ssoTogglePatchFix: Fixed enabling/disabling device SSO failing with a validation error
changes.phonehomeAuthEnabledFix: Fixed phone-home heartbeat failing on a device with local login enabled
changes.provisionWizardPlatform: "Install New" device wizard now asks which platform (Raspberry Pi 4/5 or x86 PC) before showing prep instructions, instead of assuming Raspberry Pi
changes.mfaProviderIcons: Consistent icon per MFA provider across login and settings
changes.x86PhoneHomeFix: x86 devices auto-registering via phone-home are now correctly detected instead of staying "unknown"
changes.mfaSwitchMethodFix: Fixed login getting stuck on "challenge expired" for every MFA method after the first one (e.g. Duo) denied or timed out
changes.scheduleTimelineRestored: Device details page now shows a visual day/week Schedule Timeline (default/time/event bands, display-off overlay, current time marker)
changes.sessionCookieHttpFix: Fixed login appearing to succeed but never actually persisting on a plain-HTTP deployment (session cookie was always marked HTTPS-only)
changes.mfaRateLimitFix: Fixed MFA login rate limiting counting every visitor as the same IP (nginx proxy address wasn't being forwarded to the app)
changes.privacyideaPushLoginFix: Fixed privacyIDEA push login not actually sending a push request
changes.privacyideaPushToken: privacyIDEA now also supports push-approval second factor (Firebase-free) as an alternative to typing a 6-digit code
changes.mfaProviderSettingsUI: MFA provider credentials (Duo, privacyIDEA, AuthPoint) can now be set from Settings > MFA Providers instead of only via server env vars
changes.privacyideaAutoProvision: privacyIDEA users are now auto-created on first enrolment when using privacyIDEA's own internal resolver
changes.playerDetailAccessHidden: Non-admin users no longer see a device's IP, MAC address or Tailscale IP on its detail page
changes.privacyIdeaProvider: New optional MFA provider: privacyIDEA — enroll a TOTP token against a self-hosted privacyIDEA server via QR code, same as the built-in authenticator option
changes.authpointProviderStub: Groundwork laid for a future WatchGuard AuthPoint push-MFA option (not yet connected to a live AuthPoint account)
changes.ldapLoginPrep: Groundwork laid for AD/LDAP login — admins can point the Fleet Manager at a directory server via environment variables; new LDAP users start as viewers until promoted
changes.customAnthiasImage: Own Anthias player image (x86, Pi4, Pi5) with CEC, IR, screenshot capture and self-update built in, replacing the unmaintained third-party fork
changes.migrateToMupitechImage: New "Migrate to MupiTech image" action for x86 devices
changes.officialSchedulingModel: Adopted Anthias's own simpler recurring-schedule model for content, built into each asset's editor
changes.userPrivilegeGuards: Admins can no longer edit or deactivate superadmin accounts, and no one can edit their own role/scope
changes.retroDosEasterEggs: Two new easter egg themes (retro Windows 98 style and an MS-DOS terminal look)
changes.logoRedesign: Redesigned logo with a shorter layout and a new mark
changes.standbyImageMargin: Bigger safety margin on the "no content" standby image
changes.screenshotSshRetake: Fixed being unable to capture a second screenshot over SSH after the first one
changes.deviceCardLocationOrientation: Device cards now show location and screen orientation
changes.mupitechRebrand: Rebranded to MupiTech Fleet Manager — new logo, blue color theme and Portuguese (PT) as the default language
changes.modularArchitecture: Backend reorganized into focused modules: players, groups, content, cctv, history, scheduling, locations, playlists
changes.locationsFeature: New Locations feature — organize groups and standalone devices by physical site
changes.playlistsFeature: New content Playlists — an ordered set of content that can be deployed to devices, groups or locations at once
changes.authUxImprovements: Navigation now hides menu items before login and shows a user menu with sign-out after logging in
changes.groupsNavFix: Fixed a missing "Groups" navigation link — the page always worked but had no menu entry
changes.contentLibrary: Content library with folders and type filters
changes.playbackHistory: Playback history with datetime and content filters
changes.playerScreenshots: Player screenshots with video frame capture
changes.multiLanguage: Multi-language support (EN, UK, FR, DE, PL)
changes.autoDeployUpdate: Auto-deploy via GHCR + Watchtower with update management UI
changes.cctvStreams: CCTV Streams — surveillance camera management with mosaic/rotation display modes
changes.historyFilters: History page datetime and content name filters
changes.cctvContentIntegration: CCTV streams integrated into Content page with auto-start from player schedule
changes.updateReliability: Improved auto-update reliability — update trigger no longer fails when containers restart
changes.cctvStreamFixes: CCTV stream fixes: auto-start on page open, keepalive ping, list view edit button, stable modal size
changes.reliableUpdates: Reliable update system — replaced Watchtower with docker compose-based updater, fixed stale version cache after update
changes.cctvLiveView: Live CCTV stream on player detail page — auto-refreshing snapshot with LIVE badge and keepalive
changes.cctvPolish: CCTV streams: live preview in content library, auto-restart on config change, snapshot thumbnails, player deploy with full URL
changes.friendlyUpdateUx: Friendly update UX — auto-detect version change after update and prompt page reload
changes.cctvLiveViewFix: CCTV live view fix — show live stream only when CCTV is actively running, removed manual toggle button
changes.standardPlayerCompat: Standard Anthias player compatibility — auto-detect custom features (schedule, playback control, screenshot) and hide unsupported UI elements
changes.reliableUpdateProcess: Reliable update process — removed build directive from production compose, added --no-build flag to updater
changes.cctvNowPlayingDetection: CCTV live preview now only shows when the player is actually displaying a CCTV stream, not just when a CCTV asset exists in the library
changes.emptySlotFallback: Empty schedule slots now fall back to the default slot instead of showing splash screen
changes.registerTokenAuth: Player registration endpoint secured with optional Bearer token (PLAYER_REGISTER_TOKEN)
changes.eslintSetup: ESLint 9 with TypeScript support added, moduleResolution fixed to bundler
changes.ssrfDnsFix: OG preview no longer blocks external URLs when DNS is temporarily unavailable
changes.silentExceptionLogging: Added warning logs to previously silent exception handlers (CCTV stream start, thumbnail update)
changes.forgetPlayerButton: Forget player button on player detail page — remove player from fleet manager
changes.testSuiteFix: Fixed test suite — all 28 tests pass (auth, og:image mock)
changes.cctvStreamLifecycle: CCTV stream lifecycle — ffmpeg stops on config save, restarts on preview open, stops on preview close; streams only run when needed by schedule or preview
changes.provisionPlayer: Remote provisioning — install Anthias on a fresh Raspberry Pi directly from Fleet Manager via SSH
changes.tailscaleIntegration: Tailscale VPN integration — connect to remote players via Tailscale with automatic fallback
changes.provisionFixes: Provisioning fixes — Docker group permission fix, VLC framebuffer output, viewer TTY allocation
changes.multiFileUploadFix: Fix multi-file upload — files now upload correctly and appear immediately
changes.slotLibraryFix: Fix adding content from library to schedule slot
changes.tailscaleAutoDetect: Auto-detect Tailscale VPN IP from player URL
changes.cctvSnapshotRate: CCTV stream refresh rate increased to 2 fps (every 0.5s)
changes.loginRedirectLoop: Fix login page infinite reload loop
changes.macIdentity: Player identity by MAC address — stable identification even when IP changes (DHCP)
changes.cecMonitorControl: HDMI-CEC monitor control — turn display on/off from player detail page
changes.scheduleTimelineRedesign: Schedule timeline redesign — event blocks with duration, color palette for time slots, display-off overlay
changes.slotContentModal: Slot content modal improvements — folder tabs, progress bar, duplicate check
changes.scrollOptimistic: Fix scroll jumping on slot/asset deletion (optimistic state update)
changes.tokenAuth: Token Authentication for REST API (Home Assistant integration support)
changes.hoverPreview: Hover preview on Content page (list mode) — floating popup with video/image/web preview
changes.displayOffTimeline: Fix display-off overlay on schedule timeline — now shows immediately on page load
changes.flagSwitcher: Language switcher — SVG country flags instead of text codes
changes.playbackStatsFix: Fix playback duration stats — match transcoded files by base name (video.MOV = video.mp4)
changes.rbacUsers: Role-based access control (RBAC) — admin, editor, viewer roles with user management
changes.auditLog: Audit log — track all user actions with filters and pagination
changes.remoteTerminal: Remote terminal — SSH access to players directly from the browser via WebSocket
changes.bulkProvisioning: Bulk provisioning — scan network and install Anthias on multiple Raspberry Pi at once
changes.terminalProtocolFix: Fix remote terminal — send raw ANSI text instead of JSON for proper xterm.js rendering
changes.fullAuditCoverage: Full audit log coverage — track schedule, media, deploy, CCTV, settings, CEC, and all player actions
changes.cheatsheetContainerFix: Fix terminal cheatsheet — use docker compose service names instead of hardcoded container names
changes.nginxAutoUpdate: Nginx config auto-update — WebSocket proxy config is now automatically synced on container restart
changes.terminalCheatsheet: Terminal command cheatsheet — clickable sidebar with Docker, system, network, Anthias API, and config file commands
changes.autoSshCreds: Auto-set default SSH credentials when players register via phone-home
changes.perAssetVolume: Per-asset volume control — set TV volume (0-100) and mute per schedule slot item via HDMI-CEC
changes.iconOnlyButtons: Compact icon-only action buttons on player detail page
changes.irFallbackPower: IR fallback power control — send IR power-on code when HDMI-CEC is unavailable after power loss (Samsung, LG, Sony, Panasonic, Philips + custom)
changes.pi5PlayerSupport: Raspberry Pi 5 player support — auto-detect Pi model during provisioning, separate Docker images and compose template for Pi5
changes.cctvInternetBlock: CCTV streams blocked from internet access (local/VPN only)
changes.cctvLoginRequired: CCTV page now requires authentication (replaces nginx IP block)
changes.cctvHlsPlayback: Players now stream CCTV via direct HLS video (smooth playback instead of JPEG snapshots)
changes.phonehomeMacFix: Phone-home script now sends MAC address and device info for reliable identity
changes.provisionMacDedup: Provisioning identifies players by MAC address to prevent duplicates
changes.serverTelemetry: Server telemetry dashboard — live CPU, memory, disk usage with progress bars and auto-refresh
changes.cctvGridHls: CCTV grid mode: HLS live video for RTSP cameras with automatic snapshot fallback for legacy devices
changes.cctvGridCpuFix: CCTV grid: optimized CPU — cameras scaled to cell size
changes.cctvStreamStatusFix: Fixed CCTV stream restart detection after container update
changes.irFallbackSchedule: Display power schedule: IR fallback when CEC is unavailable (cold boot / power loss)
changes.irButtonVisibility: IR Power button now visible immediately on player page load (without opening Settings)
changes.cctvEditRestart: CCTV stream auto-restarts after editing camera configuration
changes.cctvWebUrlAutoDetect: Auto-detect web URLs in CCTV config — prevents ffmpeg crash from HTTP URLs treated as RTSP
changes.cctvWebSources: CCTV grid mode: web URL sources rendered at 1920x1080 in iframe, scaled to fit grid cells
changes.cctvMosaicSimplify: Simplified mosaic editor — drag-to-swap camera positions, removed react-grid-layout dependency
changes.infiniteDuration: Infinite duration (∞) for slot items — content plays until schedule change, ideal for CCTV streams
changes.scheduleRecheck: Periodic schedule re-check every 30s during playback — new time slots take effect without waiting for current asset to finish
changes.tailscaleHostname: Tailscale provisioning now sets player name as hostname for easy identification
changes.pi5ProvisionDynamicIp: Pi5 provisioning: redis-init now detects IP dynamically instead of hardcoding, preventing stale IP after network changes
changes.fixPhonehomeAuth: Fixed phone-home script: auth header line continuation bug prevented player registration
changes.mfaTotp: Two-factor authentication (TOTP) with QR code enrollment for Fleet Manager logins
changes.mfaDuoPush: Duo Security push notification as an alternative second factor
changes.mfaCodeBoxes: 6-digit MFA code entry redesigned as individual boxes
changes.deviceRevealCredentials: Admins can reveal a device's local dashboard credentials (with password reproof)
changes.deviceSsoLogin: One-click SSO login into a device's local dashboard using your Fleet Manager account
changes.standbyVideoSupport: Standby screen now supports looping video (MP4/WebM) in addition to images
changes.accountPage: New personal "My Profile" page for account security settings, moved out of shared Settings
changes.auditNavMove: Audit Log moved out of the top navigation — now only accessible via Settings
changes.duplicateDeviceFix: Fixed a duplicate device registration bug caused by a stale entry sharing a URL with only a trailing slash difference
changes.updateCheckReleaseFix: Fixed the update checker — releases are now automatically published so it can detect new versions
changes.onboardingWizard: Forced first-login onboarding — admins can require a password change and/or MFA enrollment for new users
changes.userCreateUpdateFix: Fixed a bug where creating or editing a user could return a server error even though the change saved correctly
changes.userScopeCacheFix: Fixed user permission settings (e.g. content deletion + offline alerts) not always reflecting correctly when changed together
changes.deviceSsoDisableToggle: SSO login can now be disabled per-device from the player detail page
changes.deviceVersionRoleSplit: Devices now show the full technical build version only when accessed via SSO by an admin/superadmin — everyone else sees a simple version number
changes.mfaMethodSwitch: Login now lets you switch to your other 2FA method if you have both TOTP and Duo push enabled
changes.userModalTabs: Wider user create/edit modal with a dedicated Access tab, and a stable modal height across tabs
changes.playerListEditFix: The Edit button on the player list now opens the same full Settings modal as the player detail page, instead of an older, more limited form
changes.playerCardMobileCollapse: Player list cards are collapsible on mobile to save space, and group/location now share a single row
changes.playerDetailLocationChip: The player detail page now shows location and group next to the device name, styled like the device's own splash screen
changes.playerAccessTab: Reveal credentials, SSO login, and device replacement moved into a new Access tab in the device's Settings modal, simplifying the toolbar
changes.profileSelfEdit: "My Profile" now lets you edit your own name, email, and (admin/superadmin) offline-alert email preference
changes.deviceLoginWithFmAccount: Devices can now offer a "Fleet Manager account" sign-in option alongside the device's own local credentials
changes.playerLocationChipPill: The location/group chip on the device detail page now has a pill background for visual consistency

tailscale.title: Tailscale VPN
tailscale.description: Connect Gestor de Mupis Digitais and players via Tailscale VPN for remote access across different networks.

alerts.title: Email Alerts
alerts.description: Send admins an email when a device has been offline for longer than the threshold below. Needs email sending configured below (SMTP or Microsoft Graph).
alerts.thresholdDesc: How long a device must stay offline before an alert is sent.
alerts.introEditorDesc: Customize the offline-alert email's subject and body. Leave any field empty to use its default wording.
alerts.subjectSingleHint: Use {device_name} where the offline device's name should appear.
alerts.subjectMultipleHint: Use {count} where the number of offline devices should appear.
alerts.emailModeDesc: Used to send this alert, the email-based two-factor code, and password resets — pick how the app actually sends email.
alerts.graphDesc: For Microsoft 365 tenants that block classic SMTP AUTH. Needs an Entra ID app registration with the application (not delegated) Mail.Send permission, admin-consented — ideally scoped to the sending mailbox via an Application Access Policy.
alerts.graphSenderHint: The mailbox Graph sends as — needs a real Microsoft 365 mailbox (a shared mailbox works well) and the Mail.Send permission scoped to it.
alerts.sendTestOfflineHint: Uses the real offline-devices alert template — including your custom message above, if set — with currently offline devices, or a sample if none are offline, instead of the generic text from the test above.
alerts.testSent: Test email sent — check your inbox.
alerts.testFailed: Could not send the test email. Check the email settings.

editorPermissions.title: Editor Permissions
editorPermissions.description: Editors can always manage content on devices (assign/update/remove assets, clone content). Turn on any of the groups below to also let them handle that part of the device itself — everything stays off by default.
editorPermissions.manageDevicesDesc: Add, edit and remove device records.
editorPermissions.deviceSettingsDesc: Test connectivity and view/edit a device's own settings.
editorPermissions.powerControlDesc: Reboot and shut down devices, including bulk actions.
editorPermissions.screenshotDesc: Take a live screenshot of a device.
editorPermissions.brandingDesc: Push branding, and manage the logo/standby image.
editorPermissions.imageManagementDesc: Change image source, migrate, rebuild, restore or back up a device's image.
editorPermissions.credentialsDesc: Manage a device's SSH credentials and reveal its local dashboard login.
editorPermissions.ssoDesc: SSO login into a device and push its SSO secret.
editorPermissions.simplifiedEditorNote: The Simplified Editor role (Settings > Users) is a restricted variant of Editor: it can pick a playlist's content and deploy it, but not change which devices/groups/locations it targets — that stays admin-only.

registryMirror.title: Registry Mirror
registryMirror.description: Mirror the MupiTech player images (server/viewer/redis, all architectures) to a local Docker registry, so newly-provisioned devices on this network pull from here instead of the internet. Devices need Docker configured to trust this registry — done automatically during provisioning once enabled.
registryMirror.hostDesc: Address devices on this network can reach — usually this server's LAN IP and the published registry port (default 5050).

contentLibrary.title: Content Folders
contentLibrary.description: Mark folders as common to make them (and everything nested inside) visible to every editor, regardless of their own location/group access. Every other folder is only visible to editors whose access covers its location/group.
contentLibrary.rootVisibleDesc: Content that isn't in any folder — off by default, since it's usually meant for whoever uploaded it rather than every editor.

mfaProviders.title: MFA Providers
mfaProviders.leaveBlankToKeep: Leave blank to keep the current value.
mfaProviders.duoDescription: Push-notification 2FA via a Duo Security account. Credentials from an "Auth API" application created in the Duo Admin Panel — env vars still work if set, values entered here take priority.
mfaProviders.privacyideaDescription: TOTP 2FA via a self-hosted privacyIDEA server. Needs an admin account and a realm created on that server beforehand — env vars still work if set, values entered here take priority.
mfaProviders.piResolverHint: Only needed if this is privacyIDEA's own "internal" resolver (pi-manage resolver create_internal) — each user then gets auto-created there on first enrolment. Leave blank for an external LDAP/SQL resolver that already has these users.
mfaProviders.authpointDescription: WatchGuard AuthPoint push 2FA — credentials can be saved here for later, but this provider isn't wired up to a real integration yet, so it won't appear as a login option even once filled in.
mfaProviders.dualPolicyDescription: Users with one of the selected roles must pass two MFA challenges from different providers (e.g. Duo + an authenticator code) to log in, instead of just one. Only applies to users who already have 2+ confirmed methods — with just 1, login still uses that one alone.

brandingLibrary.empty: No images saved yet — upload one to add it to the library.
brandingLibrary.confirmDelete: Remove "{{name}}" from the library? Devices already using it keep working.

partnerLogo.title: Partner logo
partnerLogo.description: Optional logo shown next to "MupiTech" in the Gestor de Mupis Digitais's navbar (e.g. co-branding with a partner or client).

branding.title: Device Branding
branding.description: Images shown on your devices instead of Anthias's own branding. Applies fleet-wide — push it to a device from its detail page, or to a whole group from the groups page.
branding.themeLabel: Theme colors + splash-page translation (Anthias purple → blue, English → Portuguese)
branding.standbyDescription: Shown whenever a device has nothing scheduled. No default is bundled — upload a plain background here to replace Anthias's own.
branding.formatHint: Only SVG, PNG or JPEG files are supported
branding.standbyFormatHint: Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, MP4 or WEBM files are supported
branding.standbyGifHint: An animated GIF or a video (MP4/WEBM) plays as-is on the device — no conversion, no extra setup.
branding.confirmDelete: Revert to the default MupiTech logo?
branding.pushHint: Uploading here only stages the images — nothing is sent to devices automatically. Push from a device's settings or from a group's actions.
branding.pushDesc: Replaces the selected images on this device. Uses SSH once — the password isn't stored.
branding.pushDescGroup: Replaces the selected images on every device in this group. The credentials below are only used as a fallback — any device with its own saved SSH credentials uses those instead.
branding.pushAllDesc: Re-applies each device's own resolved branding (its device/group/location override, or this fleet-wide default) to every already-added device. The credentials below are only used as a fallback — any device with its own saved SSH credentials uses those instead.
branding.sshUseSaved: leave blank to use the saved password
branding.sshSaveHint: Save these credentials for this device

migrateImage.title: Migrate to MupiTech image
migrateImage.desc: Moves this device onto a chosen image, replacing whatever it's running today. The previous docker-compose.yml is backed up as .bak before anything is written.
migrateImage.targetMupitechHint: Our own build (ghcr.io/pedrom20/mupitech-player) — CEC/IR, screenshot, MupiTech branding.
migrateImage.targetOfficialHint: Genuinely unmodified upstream Anthias (ghcr.io/screenly/anthias) — no MupiTech branding or extra features. Useful to rule out a fork-specific issue, or to hand a device back to a vanilla state.
migrateImage.confirmText: This replaces the device's docker-compose.yml and restarts its containers. The previous file is kept as a .bak.
migrateImage.migrated: Device migrated to the MupiTech image
migrateImage.updated: Device updated (already on the MupiTech image)
migrateImage.backupAvailable: A backup of the previous docker-compose.yml is available.
migrateImage.restoreConfirmText: This replaces the current docker-compose.yml with the .bak backup and restarts the containers.
migrateImage.restored: Device restored to its previous image
migrateImage.rebuildHint: Deletes every container, volume and local content, and reinstalls from scratch. Doesn't touch the underlying OS.
migrateImage.rebuildConfirmText: This stops and deletes ALL containers, volumes and locally-stored content on the device (unrecoverable unless "keep current content" below is enabled), then reinstalls the MupiTech image from scratch. The underlying operating system is not affected.
migrateImage.progressWiping: Deleting containers, volumes and local content…
migrateImage.preserveContent: Try to keep the device's current content
migrateImage.preserveContentHintOn: Reads the current playlist via the device's own API before migrating, and re-creates it afterwards. Best-effort — locally-uploaded files it can't re-download are skipped.
migrateImage.preserveContentHintOff: The device will start with no content after migrating — deploy content to it again from Gestor de Mupis Digitais afterwards.
migrateImage.brandingPushedWithFailures: Branding: {{pushed}} applied, {{failed}} failed — check Settings > Branding.
migrateImage.progressPulling: Pulling and starting the new image (this can take a few minutes)…
migrateImage.progressSlow: Still going — a slow connection or a large image pull can take several minutes. This isn't stuck.
migrateImage.progressReboot: Still waiting for the device to come back after restarting — this can take a couple more minutes on some hardware. Still not stuck.

errors.no_host: Could not determine the device's host from its URL ({{url}}).
errors.no_container: No running Anthias server container was found on this device.
errors.no_compose_context: Could not determine the docker-compose project directory for this device (it may not be managed by docker compose).
errors.no_backup: No backup found at {{backup_path}} — there's nothing to restore. A backup is only created the first time a device is migrated to the MupiTech image.
errors.unsupported_device_type: Migration to the MupiTech image is not supported for this device type ("{{device_type}}").
errors.unrecognized_image: Unrecognized image on this device ("{{image}}") — refusing to migrate automatically. This device needs manual inspection first.

users.title: Users
users.superadminRoleLocked: Only a superadmin can change another superadmin's role or account status.
users.ownAccessLocked: You cannot change your own role or access scope.
users.scopeHint: Optionally restrict this user to specific locations, groups or devices. Leave everything empty for full access. A location grants its groups and devices; a group grants its devices.
users.noActivity: No recorded activity for this user.
users.receiveOfflineAlertsHint: Only applies if email alerts are enabled system-wide (Settings → Email Alerts).
users.canDeleteContentHint: Allows deleting content and branding images (moving them to the recycle bin). Turn off to let this user upload/edit content without being able to remove it.
users.mustChangePassword: Force password change on first login
users.mustChangePasswordHint: The user must set a new password before they can use the Gestor de Mupis Digitais.
users.forceMfaEnroll: Force two-factor authentication enrollment on first login
users.forceMfaEnrollHint: The user must enroll in TOTP or Duo push before they can use the Gestor de Mupis Digitais.
users.resetMfaConfirmText: They'll need to set up two-factor authentication again next time they sign in.

bulkProvision.method_range_desc: Scan a range of IP addresses for SSH access

security.title: Security
security.mfaDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a 6-digit code in addition to your password when signing in.
security.scanQrHint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy).
security.enterCodeLabel: Enter the generated code to confirm
security.disableConfirmText: Your account will then be protected by your password alone.
security.duoDescription: Approve logins with a tap in the Duo Mobile app instead of typing a code — needs a Duo account set up by an admin first.
security.duoNotConfigured: Duo isn't set up on this Gestor de Mupis Digitais instance yet.
security.duoScanHint: Scan this QR code with the Duo Mobile app.
security.duoWaitingForScan: Waiting for you to finish enrolling in Duo Mobile…
security.piDescription: Use a 6-digit code, or a push approval from the privacyIDEA Authenticator app, from a self-hosted privacyIDEA server — needs privacyIDEA set up by an admin first.
security.piScanQrHintPush: Scan this QR code with the privacyIDEA Authenticator app to finish enrolling.
security.piWaitingForApp: Waiting for you to finish enrolling in the privacyIDEA Authenticator app…
security.emailDescription: Get a 6-digit code emailed to your account address each time you sign in — no separate app needed.
security.emailUnavailable: Email sending isn't configured on this Gestor de Mupis Digitais instance yet.
security.emailSentHint: We've emailed a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to confirm.
security.dualMfaDescription: Require two MFA challenges from different providers (e.g. a code + a push) to log in, instead of just one.
security.dualMfaNotEligible: You need at least 2 confirmed MFA methods to enable this
security.dualMfaRoleRequired: Already required by the system policy for your role
